description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayDiscoveryModel component of the OpenClawDiscovery project, focusing on gateway identification, TXT record parsing, SSH target building, and discovery flow control.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModelTests
classes.description: A set of unit test functions for GatewayDiscoveryModel.

methods.name: `local gateway matches lan host`
methods.description: Tests whether the local gateway is correctly identified by matching the LAN host.

methods.name: `local gateway matches tailnet dns`
methods.description: Tests whether the local gateway is correctly identified via tailnet DNS.

methods.name: `local gateway matches display name`
methods.description: Tests identification of local gateway via display name.

methods.name: `remote gateway does not match`
methods.description: Ensures that a remote gateway is not falsely identified as local.

methods.name: `local gateway matches service name`
methods.description: Checks matching of local gateway based on service name.

methods.name: `service name does not false positive on substring host token`
methods.description: Verifies that service name matching does not produce false positives due to substring host tokens.

methods.name: `parses gateway TXT fields`
methods.description: Tests parsing of gateway TXT DNS record fields into usable configuration data.

methods.name: `parses gateway TXT defaults`
methods.description: Tests parsing logic with missing or malformed TXT record data, ensuring defaults are set correctly.

methods.name: `builds SSH target`
methods.description: Tests constructing SSH target strings from user, host, and port.

methods.name: `tailscale serve discovery continues when DNS-SD already found a remote gateway`
methods.description: Verifies discovery proceeds when a remote gateway has been found via DNS-SD.

methods.name: `tailscale serve discovery stops after serve result is found`
methods.description: Checks that discovery stops once a serving gateway is identified.

methods.name: `dedupe key prefers resolved endpoint across sources`
methods.description: Tests that the deduplication key favors gateways with resolved endpoints over unresolved ones.

methods.name: `dedupe key falls back to stable ID without endpoint`
methods.description: Verifies fallback behavior of deduplication key when endpoint data is missing.
